newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta security firm robbed of $1.3 million.
newsitem.headline: Malta security firm robbed of $1.3 million.

text.p: Thieves, including one dressed as an officer of the Group 4 security firm, robbed the firm's Malta branch on Wednesday, police said.
A man in a Group 4 uniform rang the bell of the office in Guaramangia, three kilometres (two miles) from the capital, Valletta, and was let in after being seen on a security camera.
He immediately let in two other armed men who forced the only security man on duty to open a safe.
The robbers made off with several bags, which local radio said contained Lm500,000 in cash ($1.3 million), making it the biggest robbery ever in Malta. One Lm= $2.78
